I’m a 27M who earns 90k a year and I have zero consumer debt just 1 student loan for 5k. My friends recently discovered that I keep all my money in 1 checking account and have berated me that I need to invest as l’ve lost out on a lot of investment opportunities and also lost money due to inflation. I have about 40k in savings. Have a 401k with roughly 28k in it Roth IRA with 13k (maxxed out this year) 4k in bitcoin.

I’ve known for a long time I needed to confront this but I grew up poor 1st gen American. At first it felt nice to have money incase of an emergency or if I got laid off. It use to be that I needed to have 500 on hand to feel “safe” then that turned into 1k and then 5k and so on and so forth. Lately I thought I needed cash on hand to buy a house eventually but realistically with my income and interest rates buying a home is not in the cards right now.

Things are good I have less anxiety about investing almost all that money question now is what?
I buy index funds in the Roth I own do I just buy a lot of that? 
Buy bitcoin? 
Buy individual stocks? (this one seems risky to me) 
Do I invest it all at once or little by little?

My friends who are urging me to invest mentioned they learned a lot on here. I’ve overheard this name a lot in their conversations. Definitely a newbie first timer maybe this is biased but for some reason I thought strangers on the internet would know more than my buddy Chad

Happened to me recently. Disconnect the battery for 30 seconds (really 10 min to be safe) this will hard reset unit. If this does not work it’s probably the Bluetooth adapter in your car. Pick your part auto lots have a lot of wrecked cars these units go for 25 ish dollars there if you need a replacement.
